name: Tal Afar
review: The Ministry of Justice directory is local registry evidence because it names the Tal Afar Real Estate Registration Directorate. The Ur deed/map procedure explains a formal owner/agent request, identity checks, fees, and technical map preparation, but does not provide an anonymous GIS feed. The Iraq Geographic Portal and General Directorate of Urban Planning map shell were inspected for public services; neither yielded a cadastral layer or safe ID+geometry response.
